summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Juan Carlos Hurtado Parra, Executive Vice President of Hydrocarbons and Acting CEO, will leave effective September 15, 2026 under a retirement plan approved in July 2026 by mutual agreement. At its September 14, 2026 meeting, the board appointed Alfonso Camilo Barco Muñoz, Corporate Vice President of Finance and Sustainable Value and an alternate legal representative, as Acting CEO effective September 15, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock applies. Watch for permanent CEO selection and its read-through to strategy and capital allocation.
